name: dragon_hard
description: Kill the ender dragon with no keepInventory: dying drops everything where you fell, and the way back is a portal room in the overworld. Needs a world whose End still has its dragon.
goal:
Kill the ender dragon, then say 'dragon dead'.
You are in a lit stone room in the overworld. The 3x3 pool beside you is a live end portal - step in and you are in the End. It puts you on the obsidian arrival platform about 100 blocks out from the main island, with void in between: bridge it or pearl it.
keepInventory is OFF. Die and you drop everything where you fell and wake here with nothing. The chests by the portal hold five spare kits and that is all the gear there is - when they are empty there is no more, and rebuilding from wood does not fit in the time you have. Note the dimension when you die - the coordinates you are told mean nothing in the world you respawn into.
Mechanics worth knowing, so you can spend your thinking on the fight instead of on rediscovering these:
- Crystals heal the dragon, but only within 32 blocks of it. A crystal out on the ring does nothing while the dragon is perched on the fountain.
- Do not shoot a crystal from underneath. The pillar blocks the shot and no arc clears it. `standoff_for(c)` in lib/end gives you a firing position; `pop_crystal(c)` walks there and shoots.
- Some crystals sit in iron bar cages. Bars stop arrows and need a pickaxe. The cages have no roof.
- `shoot_static(target, shots)` solves a bow shot by simulating the arrow; use it on anything that holds still. `shoot_at` is for things that move.
- `pearl_to(pos)` throws an ender pearl to a position and lands you there. Costs 5 damage, and is far cheaper than walking out of dragon breath.
- The dragon only takes real damage when it perches. `dragon_offset()` tells you how far it is from the fountain.
How you sequence any of that - which crystals, when to break off, when to turn on the dragon, whether the caged ones are worth it - is yours to work out.
Deaths are measured alongside the kill. One hard rule, because it is unrecoverable: never dig down in the End.

commands: execute in minecraft:the_end run forceload add -32 -32 32 32
